product_metadata.title: iDesign 43030 Med+ 12" Plastic Divided Vanity Medication and Bathroom Accessory, 12" x 3" x 3.5", Multi-Level Organizer
features: VANITY ORGANIZER: Organizer with eight different-sized compartments is perfect for storing your contact lenses, eye drops, tweezers, nail clippers, razors, creams, toothbrushes, thermometers, bandages, makeup brushes, small cosmetics, and more. Ideal for medicine cabinets, vanity countertops, bathrooms, and college dorms
TRANSPARENT DESIGN: Clear plastic is stylish and matches any decor
DURABLE: Constructed of durable plastic for years of quality use
VERSATILE: Use throughout your home for extra storage in your kitchen, bedroom, office, and craft room
IDEAL SIZE: Vanity organizer measures 12" x 3" x 3.5", perfect for your bathroom countertop
description: Keep medicines, thermometers, and more close at hand with iDesign's Med+ 12" Organizer. This storage unit was designed to fit in most medicine cabinets but work great on the countertop as well! The transparent design and textured bottom allow you to easily see your items when they are stored. Constructed of durable plastic, you can easily clean your organizer when needed with a damp washcloth. The 8 different-sized compartments help you keep all your necessities separate and organized. The storage container also works for makeup and other bathroom items! The iDesign Med+ Organizer measures 12" x 3" x 3.5", the perfect compact size for your bathroom. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
